sentences.en: Believe it or not, it came in pack of gum.
sentences.zh: 信不信由你，它是一包口香糖。

sentences.en: If you have gum in your mouth, spit it out.
sentences.zh: 如果你嘴里有口香糖，把它吐出来。

sentences.en: Chewing gum is a sweet which is made of rubber.
sentences.zh: 嚼口香糖是一种用橡胶制成的糖果。

senses.zh: 口香糖，树胶，橡皮(糖)，齿龈，粘性物质，牙床
搞砸，用牙床嚼，以树胶粘合
